title: Level 11: Android Internals and AOSP
description: Explain Android below the application layer through causal traces of processes, Binder, launch, rendering, ART, memory pressure, power policy, diagnostics, and physical frame presentation.
plannedTopics: Linux processes, Zygote, system_server, Binder, ServiceManager, and framework authority
Application launch, ActivityThread, windows, Loopers, Binder pools, coroutines, and deadlocks
View and Compose phases, Choreographer, RenderThread, BufferQueue, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, and display
ART, DEX, profiles, garbage collection, native memory, lmkd, power policy, diagnostics, and tap-to-display capstone

project.title: End-to-End Interaction and Runtime Investigation
project.summary: Trace a user interaction from input to physical presentation and defend runtime, memory, power, scheduling, and recovery behavior with matching AOSP evidence.

theme.mapMood: A systems map connecting framework calls to processes, queues, surfaces, and runtime state.
